title: ProgressionParty
description: Party system with XP sharing for the Progression RPG ecosystem — group up, share experience, and tackle dungeons and arenas together.
body:
# 👥 ProgressionParty

ProgressionParty lets players form groups and tackle the world together. XP sharing means everyone benefits from the grind — not just the player who landed the last hit. Built as a lightweight social layer that other Progression plugins (DungeonRW, WaveArena) hook into for group content.

## Features

- **Party creation & management** — create, disband, transfer leadership
- **Invite system** — invite, accept, deny, leave with persistent requests
- **XP sharing** — configurable XP split between party members in range
- **Party info** — see members, leader, and current size at a glance
- **NPC integration** — set a Party NPC for GUI-based party management
- **Admin tools** — reload config, inspect parties

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/party create` | Create a new party |
| `/party invite <player>` | Invite a player |
| `/party accept / deny` | Respond to an invite |
| `/party leave` | Leave your current party |
| `/party info` | Show party details |
| `/party disband` | Disband the party (leader only) |

## Dependencies

Requires **ProgressionAPI**. Integrates with the Progression Core ecosystem for shared group events.

---
Part of the **Rosewood Progression** ecosystem — built for RPG and MMO-style Paper servers.
